deviations: Reading of L274 'nine CMP-015 tiles': each tile keeps its CMP-178 card on CMP-050 (color.surface.raised, radius.card, space.inset.lg), its heading link (the region's label) and, on Trading safety, its LIVE badge, and shows CMP-015 as its body: §6 L252-254 make each tile 'CMP-178 on CMP-050 … with CMP-015 … by state', Appendix A gives CMP-178 a 'loading' state and a Loading story (L877, L880) and labels the region by its heading (L878). The heading is the tile's label, not data, so the nine regions stay named and the nine tile links stay the page's Tab stops (L285). D02's low-fi frame drew nine bars without headings (D02:311, D02 board 04).

Each tile body is one CMP-015 Shape=text Count=3 instance at the tile's inner width (275 / 643 px) and the library's 52 px height, as e42kit.tile() draws a loading tile (kit choice: no source gives the skeleton's shape or count per tile); a band's three tiles share one height (L256), 109 px by the kit's estimate.

The strip (L274 'a one-line strip skeleton'): the CMP-087 strip region keeps its 944 / 2048 px box (§4 L173-174, D1) and holds one CMP-015 Shape=text Count=1 instance at its library size (240 x 12; kit choice: no source gives its width) and no visible title: strip.title 'Needs your action ({n})' needs {n}, which no read has returned, and OV-1's copy is '—' (L274); the region keeps its name 'Needs your action' (§4 L167) as its aria-label.

The Trading-safety tile's LIVE badge is drawn while loading: it is the serving environment (§1 L102), not a slice value; §6 L250 names 'Trading safety [env]' and D02 keeps [LIVE] over an unavailable trading slice (D02:282-283).

Profiles and limits has no read today (L265: no slice, D8, CG-6), so on today's main it would show tile.not_built at once (OV-6, board 26); it is drawn loading because L274 draws nine skeleton tiles (the target, where every tile has a read). Spec gap for the owner: OV-1 could say so.

Shell: the band's right end is empty, the (b) shell with no grace (SH-6, L186; Q1 L146: '(b) is what the server does'), as board 09 draws SCR-120; the (a) badge and the (b) grace line are boards 01-05's. The PageHeader has no primary action: §6 L250 names none for SCR-120.
No focus ring is drawn: OV-1 has no focus moment (focus never moves on a route change, §4 L200).
No greyscale or deuteranopia render: board 21 is not in §0's render list (L72-73).

Links: the nine tile headings (CMP-021, the CMP-178 region's heading, §6 L252-253) are colour + position: each sits alone at its tile's top, and §15 F3 (L655) underlines headings in high contrast only; OV-1 draws no inline link (cvsheet v1 texts take no textDecoration; boards 01 and 22 draw a 1 px rect where an underline is needed).

Local helper skeleton(): every CMP-015 instance sets the props Shape and Count only. e42kit.skeleton() also sets State=default, but the E05-D02 build of 'CMP-015 · Skeleton' has Shape and Count as its only variant properties (State does not vary, so it is no property; build record d02/builds-1545.json), and cvsheet resolves a variant by every prop it is given, so a State prop would fail the live lookup; the subset still matches the offline inventory's variants (validator) and the live set either way. Board E08-D07 05 does the same.

Local helper (kit-level, review r1 of board 06 finding 6, of board 02 finding 5 and of board 21 finding 5): kit compositions take the build notes' '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)' names: 'CMP-209 RightRail (composition)' (kit: 'RightRail (composition)'; 15:2416), 'CMP-093 AuditActionTrigger (composition) · footer marker' (kit: 'footer marker (CMP-093)'; 15:893), 'CMP-087 rule (composition)' (kit: 'CMP-087 rule (4 px)'; the 4 px stays in its h and note), 'CMP-178 SystemHealthTile (composition) · <tile>' (kit: 'CMP-178 tile (composition) · <tile>'; 15:2043, as boards 22-27 and 94 name it) and, in every tile, 'CMP-021 Link (composition) · heading' (kit: 'heading'; 15:232, §6 L253). The other kit boards keep the kit's names until e42kit renames them.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes). Chrome surface (kit-level, review r1 finding 5, correcting e42kit's 'no source names a chrome surface'): `15` names color.surface.raised for CMP-071 NavRail and CMP-072 TopBar (15:699, :708) and CMP-209 RightRail (15:2421) and color.surface.sunken for CMP-208 StatusBar (15:2411). The boards draw all four on color.surface.app, CMP-070 AppShell's surface (15:690), with color.border.subtle dividers, as boards 01-11 do: D03 takes only E10's sizes (§1 L97), E10-D02 is greyscale with no bespoke colour (E10:20-21), §15 measures no chrome pair, and one chrome keeps the 103 boards comparable. Binding `15`'s surfaces is a kit change for every board (routed to the kit owner).

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

Local helper strip_skeleton(): e42kit.shell() has no loading strip, so it is built with items=() (the kit draws strip.none) and its 'CMP-087 strip (composition)' node is replaced by the OV-1 strip region holding the one-line skeleton; drop_strip_none() then removes the strip.none key the kit recorded and sync_tokens() the tokens only that line bound (type.ui.label in the frames), as nothing draws them; the column's labels bind type.ui.label again.

Local helper (kit-level, review r1 finding 1, as on boards 06 and 11): e42kit's _admin_entry marks the current Admin entry by its color.surface.selected fill alone, 1.58 / 1.40 against the rail (color.surface.app; measured from token-sync.json), under AC-5's UI bar of 3.0 (§15 L620). DS-2 binds color.border.admin to 'the 4 px rule and the current nav entry's edge' (D02:1003), taken over unchanged (spec L17-18; D02:1169), so this board draws the edge: color.text.tertiary (DS-2's fallback) at border.thick (D02 gives no width), inner; 6.29 / 6.81 / 12.54 against the rail (§15 L635, L638), 3.98 / 4.86 / 7.94 against the fill (§15 L656: F4's FAIL is the 4.5 text bar; an edge is UI, bar 3.0). The kit owner carries it into e42kit and regenerates the boards that draw the fill alone.

Local helper kit_fixups() (kit-level, review r1 of board 21 finding 6a): the footer marker's note names SCR-120's own /admin/* reads (board 26's wording with the two further reads this board's tiles wait on, GET /admin/security/summary and /admin/backups, §6 L264, L269, as board 27 lists them), where e42kit's footer_marker() note names SCR-121-123's strip reads (§4 L201-204: only /admin/* API routes write admin.area_entered; /users/* and /admin/audit write none).
